plotSections.title: Ord Attempts to Reveal Himself
bullets: Ord, apparently still invisible, considers using black powder to make himself visible but instead remembers his dragon vessel.

Ord uses the dragon vessel with olive oil, covering himself in oil in an attempt to create a visible outline. The attempt succeeds: the oil becomes visible even though Ord himself remains otherwise invisible.
The oil produces a faint, silent silhouette of Ord on the ship's top deck, allowing Dana and Ciri to see his general outline. Areas not covered by oil remain invisible.

plotSections.title: The Spectral Door and Gerk
bullets: While Ord is experimenting with visibility, Sylan continues interacting with Gerk, who is apparently affected by an unseen force.
A shiny spectral door appears hovering above Gerk. Gerk can scream, but his voice is not perceived by the others, and he appears unable to move normally.
Sylan turns Gerk's head toward the spectral door and then drags him toward it using the unseen forces affecting him.

plotSections.title: Dana's Snake as a Visibility Marker
bullets: Dana uses her serpentine bracers to summon a constrictor snake and commands it to remain at her heel as she moves.
The summoned snake is visible and therefore provides Dana with another way to track or indicate her position while the party is dealing with the unusual visibility situation.

The DM confirms that the summoned creature is a large constrictor snake and that speaking the relevant command produces two constrictor snakes, though it is left unresolved whether Dana can release them individually.

chronologicalEvents: Ord considers using black powder from the ship to make himself visible, then remembers his dragon vessel and abandons the powder idea.
Ord uses his dragon vessel with olive oil, covering himself in oil on the ship's top deck.
The oil becomes visible as a faint silhouette around Ord, allowing Dana and Ciri to see his general outline while Ord himself remains invisible.
A shiny spectral door appears above Gerk while unseen forces shake and manipulate him.
Gerk screams, but the others cannot hear him; Sylan turns Gerk toward the spectral door and drags him toward it.
Dana uses her serpentine bracers to summon a visible constrictor snake and commands it to stay at her heel as a positional marker.
The DM establishes that the summoned creature is a large constrictor snake and that the relevant command produces two constrictor snakes.

notes: Ord is currently invisible except where substances or creatures provide a visible indication of his position.
Ord discovered that applying olive oil through his dragon vessel creates a visible, faint outline of his otherwise invisible body.
The visible oil silhouette is silent but has a physical presence on the deck as the oil splashes and drips.
Ord attempted to communicate in Draconic while investigating whether anyone was present, but no response is established in this chunk.
personality: Ord is willing to improvise with unusual methods and items when trying to solve the visibility problem.
quotesThemes: Using the dragon vessel and olive oil as a makeshift method of revealing his location.
openQuestions: Who or what, if anything, can perceive Ord while he is invisible?

notes: Ord possesses a dragon vessel that can apparently be used with olive oil to create a visible outline around his otherwise invisible body.
The exact mechanics and limitations of the dragon vessel are not established in this chunk.
openQuestions: What are the full properties and intended uses of Ord's dragon vessel?

notes: Gerk is currently being affected by an unseen force that shakes and moves him despite his apparent inability to move normally.
A shiny spectral door is hovering above Gerk while he is being manipulated.
Gerk can physically move his mouth and scream, but his voice is not heard by the surrounding party members.
Sylan is able to physically reposition Gerk's head and drag his body toward the spectral door.
quotesThemes: Gerk's confused attempts to communicate while apparently isolated from the others.
openQuestions: What is the spectral door and what is causing Gerk to be isolated and manipulated?
Why can Gerk hear his own scream while the others cannot hear him?

notes: A shiny, floating spectral door appears above Gerk while unseen forces are manipulating him.
Sylan directs Gerk toward the door, but its destination or function is not established in this chunk.
openQuestions: What is the spectral door and where does it lead?
Why has the spectral door appeared over Gerk?

Dana.existing: Half-elf cleric and the most knowledgeable member of the group.
notes: Dana still has her serpentine bracers equipped.

Dana commands the summoned snake to remain at her heel, using it as a visible positional marker while she moves.
personality: Dana responds methodically to the unusual visibility situation by creating an external marker she can keep with her.
openQuestions: Can Dana choose to release the two constrictor snakes produced by the command one at a time?
